text:
Rina (Design): Quick review: new confirmation modal when a user turns off automatic retries on the request settings page. Current header: "Turn off retries?" Feels terse.
Leo (PM): Yup. We need to surface the consequence (failed requests, higher latency) and the scope (workspace vs request).
Casey (Eng): Technically it's a workspace-level flag for SDKs but UI toggles per-route. We should be explicit: "Stop automatic retries for this route" or "for this workspace"?
Nora (Docs): If it's inconsistent, that's confusing. Lean toward "for this route" in the UI and note the workspace impact in the docs. I'll prep a snippet.
Rina (Design): Proposed header: "Disable automatic retries for this route" Body: "Requests that fail due to transient errors will not be retried automatically if you disable retries. This may increase failed responses or surface transient errors to your app." Too wordy?
Devon (SRE): Good content. Shorten first sentence for compact screens: "Transient failures won't be retried automatically." Also suggest adding a small bold line: "Action is reversible from Settings > Requests."
a11y-bot: Modal must have aria-live for status updates and link text should not be ambiguous. Prefer "Read about retry behavior and idempotency" over "Learn more". Ensure focus goes to the modal heading on open.
Casey (Eng): Button labels: primary = "Disable retries" (destructive), secondary = "Keep retries". Should we add a tertiary "Remind me later"? That might be unnecessary.
Leo (PM): Tertiary invites indecision. Keep two buttons. Also add a small toggle note: "SDKs may cache this setting for up to 5 minutes" so users understand propagation lag.
Rina (Design): Microcopy proposal: Header: "Disable automatic retries for this route"
Body: "Transient failures won't be retried automatically. Disabling retries may increase failed responses or cause higher latency for callers."
[Read about retry behavior and idempotency]
Primary button: "Disable retries" (red)
Secondary button: "Keep retries"
Note under buttons (smaller text): "This change takes up to 5 minutes to propagate to SDKs. Admins can reverse this in Settings > Requests."
Nora (Docs): I will create the doc section and suggest slug `/docs/retries-idempotency`. Suggested link label: "Read about retry behavior and idempotency".
Devon (SRE): Telemetry: `retries_disabled` event with actor, route_id, and propagation_time. Also add an oncall note: disabling retries has caused transient spikes in error rate before.
Casey (Eng): Add a unit test to ensure the modal is keyboard-focusable and screenreader reads heading+description. a11y-bot: Confirmed headings and aria-describedby once updated.
Rina (Design): I'll update the Figma with the revised copy and post link here. Anyone object to shipping this in the next patch?
Leo (PM): No objections. I'll track translation PR. Nora, please post doc link when available.
Nora (Docs): On it 44d I'll share the slug before EOD.
Rina (Design): Closing thread after Figma/PR/doc links. Thanks!
